sentences.text: There is a big tree in the yard.
Birds sit on the tree.
The child sat under the tree.
There are many animals in the forest.
We want to go to the forest.
A dark forest is scary at night.
The dog brought a stick.
The child holds a stick in his hand.
We need a stick to start a fire.
I buy fresh fruit at the market.
Fruit is good for breakfast.
My mother washes the fruit.
The farmer sows seed on the ground.
A small sprout grows from the seed.
This seed is for vegetables.
A green leaf fell from the tree.
In autumn the leaf turns yellow.
The child collected leaves.
The tree has a deep root.
The root takes water from the earth.
We pulled the plant out by the root.
The tree's bark is dry.
Bark protects the tree.
The dog chewed the bark.
There is a red flower in the garden.
She waters the flower.
The flower has a nice smell.
Cows eat grass.
The grass is green after rain.
Children play on the grass.
A rope must be strong.
He tied the box with a rope.
They pull the boat with a rope.
Human skin is soft.
The sun can burn the skin.
I put cream on my skin.
We eat meat for dinner.
This meat is fresh.
She cooks meat in the kitchen.
A little blood came from the wound.
Blood has a red color.
The doctor checked the blood.
The dog loves a bone.
There is a bone in my hand.
Fish has many bones.
This meat has a lot of fat.
There is fat in the food.
He does not like to eat fat.
The hen laid an egg.
I cook an egg for breakfast.
The egg is in the box.
The ox has a long horn.
A horn is hard.
He blows a horn.
The cat wagged its tail.
The dog shows joy with its tail.
A monkey has a long tail.
The bird has a soft feather.
A feather flies in the wind.
The child picked up a feather from the ground.
She poured water on her hair.
His hair is black.
She combs her hair.
I want to rest my head.
I put a hat on my head.
The child nodded his head.
I hear sound with my ear.
Clean the ear carefully.
The cat has big ears.
The eye is needed for seeing.
Her eye is brown.
Dust went into the eye.
I breathe through my nose.
The nose is cold.
The dog smells with its nose.
I can open my mouth.
He put food into his mouth.
The child closed his mouth.
Cleaning the tooth is important.
One tooth hurts me.
The baby has a first tooth.
I taste with my tongue.
The tongue is red.
The cat stuck out its tongue.
I need to cut my nail.
She has a long nail.
The nail broke on the door.
The foot is on the sand.

sentences.target: የእግር መዳፍ ከረጅም መራመድ በኋላ ደክሟል።
sentences.text: The foot is tired after a long walk.
A shoe protects the foot.
The leg is long.

sentences.target: በ እግር ወደ ትምህርት ቤት እሄዳለሁ።
sentences.text: I go to school on foot.
The leg is below the knee.
The knee is tired after running.
The child fell on his knee.
The knee can bend.
Washing the hand is important.
I hold the book in my hand.
The right hand is strong.
The bird has a wide wing.
A wing is needed for flying.
The butterfly moved its wing.
The belly is full.
After food the belly rests.
After eating a lot the belly settles.
My throat is dry.
Water soothes the throat.
When the throat hurts, speaking is hard.
The neck is long.
I put a scarf on my neck.
I can turn my neck.

sentences.target: ከከባድ ሥራ በኋላ ጀርባ ማረፍ ይፈልጋል።
sentences.text: After hard work the back needs rest.
I carry the book on my back.
I rest my back on the chair.
A mother nurses a baby at the breast.
The breast is on the chest.
The doctor examined the breast.
The heart beats quickly.
The heart is inside the chest.
Joy warms the heart.
The liver is inside the belly.
The doctor examined the liver.
A healthy liver is important.
Drinking water is healthy.
After sport I want to drink coffee.
The child likes to drink milk.
I like to eat injera.
It is time to eat lunch.
It is better to eat slowly.
A dog bite is dangerous.
It is easy to bite injera.
The child started to bite an apple.
A baby likes to suck milk.
I can suck juice through a straw.
Sucking is natural for babies.
Spitting on the road is not proper.
Clean your mouth before you start to spit.
The patient needed to spit.
The baby started to vomit.
After I got sick I felt like vomiting.
Vomiting can be a symptom.
It is easy to blow out a candle.
The wind can blow dust.
The child likes to blow a balloon.
Breathing deeply relaxes you.
After a run, breathing is hard.
Breathing clean air is good.
My friend likes to laugh.
The film made us laugh.
Laughing from the heart feels good.
